items.title: NVIDIA/auto-ontology
items.description: Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows.
items.author: NVIDIA
items.summary_zh: NVIDIA 开源了 Auto Ontology（Apache-2.0），一个用 Python 编写的库，可从企业元数据生成本体、打通跨系统的指标口径，并搭建 AI 就绪的知识图谱。它给 agent 提供指标、实体与关系的业务含义，用认证定义和血缘校验生成的查询并附带来源，再通过 MCP、CLI 和 API 暴露给任意 agent 框架，适合在意 agentic analytics 结果准确性的团队。
items.summary_en: NVIDIA's Auto Ontology is an open-source Python library (Apache-2.0) that builds a semantic, graph-based context layer from enterprise metadata: it generates ontologies, reconciles conflicting metric definitions across systems and produces AI-ready knowledge graphs. Agents get grounding for metrics and entities, query validation against certified definitions and lineage, plus provenance, with context served to any agent harness via MCP, CLI or API. Aimed at teams where a fast but wrong agent answer is worse than none.

items.title: The 'Astra can read and write weights to improve Qwen' post is misleading
items.author: syllogism
items.summary_zh: Hacker News 上的一则帖子指出，「Astra 能读写权重来改进 Qwen」的说法具有误导性：读取原始权重的那批实验，与真正修好 Qwen 的实验，用的是完全不同的技术手段。对关注权重编辑和模型改造的人，这是一条提醒——把两组实验并置，容易让人以为它们之间存在并不成立的因果关系。
items.summary_en: A Hacker News submission argues that the circulating claim "Astra can read and write weights to improve Qwen" is misleading, because the experiments that read raw weights and the ones that actually fix Qwen use completely different techniques. items.summary_zh: pbakaus/impeccable 是一套给 coding agent 用的设计词汇表：用 polish、bolder 这类指令控制打磨方向，用 critique、audit 做评审与检查，目标是在界面交付前拦住 AI 生成的粗糙产物（AI slop）。适合已经在用 agent 写前端、又想把设计质量纳入流程的开发者。
items.summary_en: impeccable, a GitHub project by pbakaus, packages a design vocabulary for coding agents: steer work with polish and bolder, review it with critique and audit, and catch AI slop before it ships. It suits developers who let agents write UI code and want design quality built into the loop rather than fixed up afterwards.

items.title: affaan-m/ECC
items.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
items.author: affaan-m
items.summary_zh: ECC 是一套面向 AI coding agent 的 harness 性能优化系统，把 skills、instincts、memory、security 与 research-first development 这几块能力打包在一起，兼容 Claude Code、Codex、Opencode、Cursor 等工具。适合同时使用多个 coding agent 的开发者参考其模块划分方式。原文只提供了一段简介，未给出实现细节。
items.summary_en: ECC is a harness performance optimization system for AI coding agents, bundling skills, instincts, memory, security, and a research-first development approach. It targets Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and similar tools. Developers who juggle more than one coding agent may get ideas from how it splits those concerns, though the listing only gives a one-line description and no implementation details.
